flow: ui-path — open mail.google.com/mail/u/0/ in the session and read the site's own rendered conversation list

steps.note: Must run in a session that measurably shows the logged-in inbox. Anonymous/no-session → the site itself redirects to accounts.google.com (MEASURED 2026-09-23, 302, content-length:0); the runner then reports honest ok:false with the sign-in reason — never a fabricated read.

Known-stable Gmail conversation-row surface (DOM-UNVERIFIED — re-tune against a real session on first capture). The row carries the sender + snippet + relative date; a row entering focus renders the open thread.

Per row: subject (.y6 or span[role='link']), sender (.bog / b.Email), snippet (.y2 /* tellRow */), date (.xW or [role='gridcell'] time title), read state (tr.zA vs tr.zE unread; dot indicator [role='link'] + base64 IMG). DOM-UNVERIFIED — every field re-read from the live DOM.

output.rows: array<{id, subject, sender, snippet, dateTag, unread}>

rpc: none — Gmail's internal RPC bridge is deliberately not driven (no fabricated traffic). Reads happen off the rendered page.
stealth: plain page load + DOM read in the user's own logged-in session — indistinguishable from a human opening Gmail
